children.title: Cycle 41 · WAKE Architectural Stability and Accountability Inquiry

detail.title: WAKE Architectural Stability and Accountability Inquiry
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the statelessness of WAKE's provider architecture by revising the hypothesis regarding durable state and defining a follow-up experiment to isolate potential environmental caching. The objective remains to determine if continuity is exclusively mediated by the durable record.
